description: Use this when asking 'How much would new flooring cost for the rooms in my house?' or 'Can you compare installed costs for hardwood, laminate, and vinyl using my room sizes?'. Returns national installed ranges (labor and materials), no labor-only figure, and no published typical figure. One call compares all eight materials using net room area, with hardwood order guidance, an unpriced prep checklist, a separate historical Census reference card and dated sources. Pure arithmetic, no network or model. (API Tool Calls, by Cowerx)

layout.description: Only changes the hardwood order amount: standard 5%, diagonal 10%. Installed estimate always uses net area.

material.description: Chosen installed material; one call also compares all eight materials.

rooms.description: 1–20 rooms, each 1–5,000 sq ft; total 10–10,000 sq ft. Use length_ft + width_ft OR area_sqft per room.

area_sqft.description: Area in square feet instead of both dimensions.

length_ft.description: Positive length in feet; use with width_ft OR area_sqft.

name.description: Optional room name, at most 40 characters.

width_ft.description: Positive width in feet; use with length_ft OR area_sqft.

name: flooring_cost
title: Flooring Cost Calculator
